newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hanwa Bank ask-only after suspension.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa Bank ask-only after suspension.

text.p: Hanwa Bank Ltd shares resumed trade on the Osaka Securities Exchange on Friday after being suspended for the whole day on Thursday, but were ask-only in mid-morning trade.
As of 0055 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 216 yen. On Wednesday, the shares settled at 236 yen.

On Thursday, the Ministry of Finance announced that it halted operations at the second-tier regional bank based in western Japan, except for withdrawals of deposits, because the bank could not recover its bad loans and was unable to operate as a going concern.
The Osaka bourse later announced that the regional bank's shares would be delisted from the exchange on February 22.
